texts.li: [hide] {FACTION} have an old map painted on a hide, kept at {PLACE} for generations. It shows a cache hidden in ruins close to the colony, and they ask the colony to go and bring it back for them.
[parchment] {FACTION} have found an old map drawn on parchment in a chest at {PLACE}. It shows a cache hidden in ruins close to the colony, and they ask the colony to go and bring it back for them.
[survey] {FACTION} have an old survey map from before the towns were rebuilt. It shows a cache hidden in ruins close to the colony, and they ask the colony to go and bring it back for them.
[slate] {FACTION} have recovered an old data slate with a map on it. It shows a cache hidden in ruins close to the colony, and they ask the colony to go and bring it back for them.

li.label: Accept the terms
li.outcome: {FACTION} have marked the ruins for the colony.

terms.li: If the colony agrees, the ruins are marked on the world map. They are within three tiles of the colony, about a day on foot. Send a caravan there within {DAYS}, find the old cache in the ruins and bring it home to the colony. Their people then come for it and pay {ITEM}. Whatever else is lying with the cache, the colony may keep.\n\nIf the cache is not brought home in time, or it is destroyed, {FACTION} will be disappointed in the colony.

accepted.li: The ruins are marked on the world map, {TALE}. Send a caravan there and bring the old cache home.

ready.li: The old cache is at the colony, and {FACTION}'s people are coming for it.

reminder.li: The old cache in the ruins has not been brought home yet.

done.li: [returned] The colony brought the old cache home from the ruins, and {FACTION}'s people have it now. They paid {ITEM}.

fail.li: [lost] The old cache from the ruins is gone. {FACTION} are disappointed in the colony.
[notfound] The colony did not bring the old cache home from the ruins in time. {FACTION} are disappointed in the colony.
[ended] {FACTION} no longer need the colony to fetch their cache.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and will not come for the cache.
